description.en: <html>Channels a holy prayer that heals all of your party members within a 20 yard radius for <r name = "var0"/> every 2 seconds.</html>
<html>Causes Holy Blast and Celestial Blast to increase the range of Verdict and Judgment by 10 yards for 6 seconds when using a one-handed weapon.</html>
<html>Causes Holy Blast and Celestial Blast to increase the range of Verdict and Judgment by 20 yards for 6 seconds when using a one-handed weapon.</html>
<html>Causes Holy Blast and Celestial Blast to increase the range of Verdict and Judgment by 40 yards for 6 seconds when using a one-handed weapon.</html>
<html>Increases the damage dealt and healing done by your Holy spells by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>
<html>Decreases the mana cost of Holy Blast, Celestial Blast, Devoted Plea, and Dedicated Plea by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>
<html>Causes Holy Blast and Celestial Blast to inflict 5% more damage when the target is affected by the Cleansing Flame effect.</html>
<html>Causes Holy Blast and Celestial Blast to inflict 10% more damage when the target is affected by the Cleansing Flame effect.</html>
<html>Causes Holy Blast and Celestial Blast to inflict 15% more damage when the target is affected by the Cleansing Flame effect.</html>
<html>Grants your Holy spells a 15% chance to not cancel the Spiritual Focus effect. Decreases the cooldown duration of Holy Shield by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>

<html>Grants the Fanaticism effect a <r name="var0"/>% chance to apply the Zealotry effect which decreases the cast time of Holy Blast and Celestial Blast by 100% and the mana cost of Holy Blast and Celestial Blast by 70% for 30 seconds. After 3 seconds, casting a spell has a 10% chance to cancel the Zealotry effect.</html>
<html>Decreases the cast time of Heavenly Miracle and Resurrection by <r name="var0"/>%. Decreases the cast time of Heavenly Smite, Holy Blast, and Celestial Blast by <r name="var1"/>%.</html>

<html>Increases your magical resistance and armor by <r name="var0"/>% for 10 seconds after your health drops below 50% of your maximum health. This effect may not happen more than once every 40 seconds.</html>
<html>Increases your Faith and Perception by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>
<html>Calls upon holy energy to inflict <r name = "var0"/> damage.</html>
<html>Increases the damage dealt by Heavenly Smite by 5% and the radius of Heavenly Smite by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>
<html>Increases the damage dealt by Heavenly Smite by 10% and the radius of Heavenly Smite by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>
<html>Increases the damage dealt by Heavenly Smite by 15% and the radius of Heavenly Smite by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>
<html>Grants Holy Blast and Celestial Blast a <r name="var1"/>% chance to heal you for <r name = "var0"/>.</html>

<html>Causes Holy Blast, Celestial Blast, and Heavenly Smite to increase your Perception by <r name="var0"/>% for 10 seconds. Effect can stack up to 3 times.</html>

<html>Increases the critical strike chance of Holy Blast, Celestial Blast, Heavenly Smite, Cleansing Flame, Devoted Plea, Dedicated Plea, Divine Prayer, Holy Rejuvenation, and Holy Healing by <r name="var0"/>% of your current critical strike chance.</html>

<html>Grants Holy Blast and Celestial Blast a <r name="var0"/>% chance to apply the Sudden Smite effect which decreases the cast time of your next Heavenly Smite by 100%. Effect can stack up to 3 times.</html>

<html>Increases the damage dealt by Verdict and Judgment by <r name="var0"/>% when the target's health is below 30% of their maximum health. Increases the damage dealt by your Lightning spells by <r name="var1"/>%.</html>
<html>Increases your Endurance by <r name="var0"/>% and applies 1 stack of the Fanaticism effect when you receive a critical strike.</html>
<html>Increases your Endurance by <r name="var0"/>% and applies 2 stacks of the Fanaticism effect when you receive a critical strike.</html>
<html>Increases your Endurance by <r name="var0"/>% and applies 3 stacks of the Fanaticism effect when you receive a critical strike.</html>
<html>Increases your Conviction by <r name="var0"/>% and causes Holy Rage to decrease the target's movement speed by 50% for 2 seconds when using a two-handed weapon.</html>
<html>Increases your Conviction by <r name="var0"/>% and causes Holy Rage to decrease the target's movement speed by 50% for 4 seconds when using a two-handed weapon.</html>
<html>Increases your Conviction by <r name="var0"/>% and causes Holy Rage to decrease the target's movement speed by 50% for 6 seconds when using a two-handed weapon.</html>
<html>Causes all demons within a 15 yard radius to flee in terror for 10 seconds.</html>

<html>Increases the damage dealt by your physical spells by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>

Grants your Holy spells a 30% chance to cancel 50% of the stacks of the Fanaticism effect on you instead of canceling 100% of the stacks of the Fanaticism effect on you.
Grants your Holy spells a 45% chance to cancel 50% of the stacks of the Fanaticism effect on you instead of canceling 100% of the stacks of the Fanaticism effect on you.

<html>Increases your chance to block by <r name="var0"/>% of your current chance to block and increases your chance to dodge by <r name="var1"/>% of your current chance to dodge when using a two-handed weapon. Decreases the duration of movement impairing effects by <r name="var2"/>%.</html>

<html>Utters a holy word that makes the target unable to cast spells for 6 seconds.</html>

<html>Decreases the mana cost and cooldown duration of Verdict, Judgment, and Holy Rage by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>

This effect may not happen more than 5 times every 1.15 minutes. Increases the duration of the Perpetual Healing effect by <r name="var1"/>%.</html>

<html>Places an enchantment on a friendly target that heals the target for <r name = "var0"/> when the target's health drops below 35%. Only 1 target can be affected by the Divine Foresight effect at a time.</html>

<html>Increases your Willpower by <r name="var0"/>%. Increases the damage dealt by Holy Blast, Celestial Blast, Heavenly Smite, Verdict, Judgment, and Holy Rage and the direct damage dealt by Cleansing Flame by <r name="var1"/>% against demons.</html>
<html>Grants Cleansing Flame a <r name="var0"/>% chance to increase the damage dealt by your next Holy spell by 25%.</html>
<html>Burns the target with holy energy that inflicts <r name = "var0"/> damage and engulfs them in a holy fire that inflicts <r name = "var1"/> damage every 2 seconds for 14 seconds.</html>

<html>Increases your damage dealt to targets that use mana by <r name="var0"/>%. Increases the healing done by Devoted Plea, Dedicated Plea, Holy Rejuvenation, and Holy Healing to targets that use energy by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>
